title: MCP Tool Node
description: Invoke a named tool on an MCP server integration

integration_id.description: UUID of the mcp_server integration that provides the tool (value supports templating)

tool_name.description: Name of the MCP tool to invoke (value supports templating)

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the MCP tool (values support templating)

timeout_seconds.description: Deadline for the tool call in seconds. Defaults to the node's resolved engine timeout.

resultSchema.description: Result structure available in result namespace (discriminated union)

tool_name.description: Name of the tool that was invoked

integration_id.description: UUID of the mcp_server integration that served the call

result.description: Tool result content returned by the MCP server

is_error.description: True when the MCP server flagged the tool result as an error

oneOf.title: Failed Result
oneOf.description: All executor fields are present but nullable. A null value means the failure occurred before that field was available.
